snippet.title: Waxheart Teaser IndieMania 2025
snippet.description:
WaxHeart is an atmospheric horror puzzle adventure where you play as a wax boy with a lantern for a heart, journeying through a dark, ruined world in search of his lost memory. It’s an adventure set in a sunless world filled with monsters and mysteries. The light from your lantern-heart helps you find your way through the darkness, but also alerts monsters of your presence. As you explore, you will discover the cruel fate of the world, and the role you play in it.

Store Link https://store.steampowered.com/app/2381630/WaxHeart/

IndieMania is the ultimate online event for indie game lovers. It’s a digital showcase of the best indie games from developers all around the world, featuring exclusive demos, interviews, live streams, and more. Whether you’re into action, adventure, puzzle, or simulation, you’ll find something to suit your taste at IndieMania. Join us in 2024 for our first online event and discover the hidden gems of the indie gaming scene.
